body:
Please share a minimal runnable example that reproduces the deadlock, including the `Live` setup and concurrent stdout or stderr writes, along with the output of `python -m rich.diagnose`. The report already gives the Rich and Python versions and platform; the reproducer and diagnose output will help determine whether this is a Rich lock-order issue.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
